subject: Daz
fact: Daz is currently guiding the boat through treacherous rock formations in the Darklake, shouting directional commands to avoid collisions after perceiving hidden obstacles others cannot see.
source_quote: Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks. On my say, heave port or starboard! Port! Starboard!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a short, resilient dwarf who has just survived falling into the Darklake alongside Grygum and Daz, observing demonic manta-like creatures feeding on flesh and questioning the implications of their presence.
source_quote: It’s good to be short... The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here. They look like manta rays, whose jaws... have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a tactically minded observer who muses on the utility of magical darkness and sees another boat with Kuotoans ahead, reflecting on his reluctant involvement in a ritual that may have summoned Demogorgon.
source_quote: The ability to cast magical darkness and see through it opens up so many tactical opportunities... There’s another boat ahead with some Kuotoans.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has recovered from the trauma of Demogorgon’s appearance and now serves as the group’s navigator, guiding them to sources of drinkable water and edible food during their journey.
source_quote: Enlightment is necessary! We must change as a people. Our imagination brought into existence, Leemooggoogoon.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is the group’s bold leader who confronted the Kuotoan Monitors with divine authority, secured their cooperation, and later articulated the group’s realization that demons have breached the Prime Material Plane in force.
source_quote: The spectator warned us about demons. And we saw the demons in Velkynvelve. Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is a skeptical scholar who recognizes Demogorgon as a being of the Prime Material Plane and warns that the summoning of demon lords poses an existential threat to all of Faerûn, especially surface dwellers like dwarven miners.
source_quote: That was Demogorgon. He’s in the prime material plane. That is not possible... The danger to all of Faerûn is undeniable. Even if we escape the Underdark, these demons won’t stay down here.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a pragmatic warrior who witnessed Eldeth’s disbelief about Demogorgon’s presence and now holds the group’s collective insight, silently processing the implications of demonic incursions.
source_quote: I am not sure what you think is or is not possible, but I saw what I saw.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido, formerly gagged, is now an unbound informant with ties to Gracklstugh and offers the group access to underground networks for acquiring equipment and supplies.
source_quote: Gracklstugh! I know people... Yes, and I know people who can help you.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait carries Shuushar and wails in terror at the escalating demonic threat, embodying the group’s dread over the Underdark’s transformation into a realm of rampaging demons and demon lords.
source_quote: This is so not good. The Underdark isn’t a friendly place! And rampaging demons and demon lords!

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a weary member of the crew, visibly cramped in the low-ceilinged boat, and shares the group’s growing anxiety over their perilous journey through the Darklake.
source_quote: Where to next?

subject: Kuotoan Monitors
fact: The Kuotoan Monitors are enforcers who guarded the dock at Sloobludop but were persuaded by Grygum’s divine command from the Archpriest of the Sea Mother to abandon their post and assist the community.
source_quote: The Archpriest of the Sea Mother commands them to help the rest of their community.

subject: Demonic Manta Rays
fact: Demonic manta rays inhabit the Darklake, possessing powerful rending jaws instead of filter-feeding apparatuses, and are remnants of the same creatures that devoured the Kuotoans of Sloobludop.
source_quote: They look like manta rays, whose jaws, instead of being used to filter plankton, have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims.

subject: Demogorgon
fact: Demogorgon, a demon prince, has manifested in the Prime Material Plane, destroyed Sloobludop, and is the catalyst for the group’s realization that demons have breached the barriers between planes in unprecedented numbers.
source_quote: Demogorgon is advancing in that direction... Demogorgon destroy the town of Sloobludop—the screams of the Kuotoans echo in the darkness.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a subterranean waterway filled with treacherous rocks, low ceilings, and now infested with demonic manta rays, serving as the current route of escape for the group.
source_quote: The boat is heading straight for the first rock... The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop was a Kuotoan village destroyed by Demogorgon, where the group previously encountered Monitors and boarded their boat, now a charred ruin echoing with the screams of its dead inhabitants.
source_quote: Demogorgon destroy the town of Sloobludop—the screams of the Kuotoans echo in the darkness.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a known dwarven stronghold or settlement in the Underdark, referenced by Buppido as a destination where the group can acquire better equipment and connect with allies.
source_quote: Gracklstugh! I know people.

subject: The Boat
fact: The boat is a small, overcrowded vessel that has carried the group from Sloobludop through the Darklake, now equipped with rowers and capable of quiet navigation to avoid detection.
source_quote: They board the boat and float away, paddling quietly not to be heard.

subject: Demon Incursion into Prime Material Plane
fact: Demogorgon’s appearance in the Prime Material Plane has triggered the group’s collective realization that demons are no longer confined to the Abyss or Underdark, but are invading surface realms in force.
source_quote: Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!

subject: Summoning of Demon Lords
fact: The group deduces that the presence of demon lords like Demogorgon in the Prime Material Plane requires immense, rare summoning magic, suggesting a coordinated, large-scale ritual effort by unknown forces.
source_quote: Demons do not just appear in the Underdark. They must be summoned. And the spell to summon a demon lord is some mighty magic.

subject: Warning to the Surface Worlds
fact: The group recognizes the need to deliver a warning about demonic incursions to the surface realms, particularly targeting dwarven mining communities at risk of annihilation.
source_quote: We need to get a warning to the surface worlds. Dwarven miners are at risk!

subject: 4th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: On this date, Daz navigates the boat through rock formations in the Darklake, marking the first time the group faces direct environmental danger requiring his unique perception.
source_quote: Standing on the front of the boat, Daz looks into the darkness... Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks.

subject: 6th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: On this date, Thorin falls into the Darklake and encounters demonic manta rays, confirming the spread of demonic fauna into the group’s current route of travel.
source_quote: Thorin reaches up and touches the cave's ceiling... The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here.

subject: 8th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: On this date, Zalthir observes another boat with Kuotoans ahead, signaling the increasing complexity of the Darklake’s ecosystem and the presence of other survivors or factions.
source_quote: There’s another boat ahead with some Kuotoans.
